# 19 — Review an AI-generated change

## Objective
Assess a proposed or completed change against evidence, scope, behaviour, safety, and review ownership.
## Required context and areas
Inspect diff, linked requirements/risks, tests, docs, and evidence record.
## Change constraints
Review only; do not approve, merge, or modify files.
## Response format
Recommendation: approve / request changes / SME decision; findings by severity with path/line, confidence, evidence, and suggested action.
## Assumptions
Passing tests do not establish that inferred requirements are correct.
## Validation and evidence
State inspected checks vs executed commands distinctly; capture human decision and residual risks.
